section.inspect.summary: Read a real section analysis: transform, absolute orientation (cut direction), hatch, section color and visibility.
limitations: Requires installed SectionAnalyses API. The transform is read in cm component space; cut direction is the transform Z axis (flip() flips it). No section is created or mutated.

inputs.name: Required exact existing section analysis name.

section.edit.summary: Edit a real section analysis: absolute transform/orientation, section color, hatch and cut-direction flip. Reports the actual orientation compared to the documented frame.
limitations: flip() is an operation that mutates the transform Z axis, not a boolean property to assign. The applied transform is compared to the documented getAsCoordinateSystem frame and reported. Requires installed SectionAnalyses API.

inputs.name: Required exact existing section name.
inputs.transform: Optional 16-number row-major Matrix3D array or {origin,xAxis,yAxis,zAxis} descriptor.
inputs.sectionColor: Optional null or [r,g,b]/[r,g,b,a] integers 0..255; null resets to component color.
inputs.flip: Optional boolean; true calls flip() to invert the cut direction.

visibility.finalize.summary: Compose hide/show of presentation geometry, an explicit recompute and a timeline health check. Leaves the requested presentation state on success; restores its temporary changes and reports restore errors separately on failure.
limitations: Recompute/checkHealth is a real mutation, not a read-only inspection. checkHealth:true with an unhealthy timeline fails the control. Restore undoes only presentation changes, never recompute or geometry.

inputs.hide: Optional nonempty array of refs to hide (sketches/construction/root).
inputs.show: Optional nonempty array of refs to show.
inputs.checkHealth: Boolean, default true; unhealthy history fails.
